firstResults.subject: Your first results are ready: {brand}

firstResults.body: AI assistants have answered {brand}'s prompts for the first time. See where you stand against your competitors, and the first actions in the Action Center.
firstResults.footer: We send this once, when your first tracking finishes.

ownKey.title: Your AI key for Ansvisor isn't working
ownKey.reminderSubject: Reminder: your AI key for Ansvisor still isn't working
ownKey.body: {why} Chat and agents in {workspace} run on this key, so agents that use it are paused. None of their runs moved to your plan's AI limit.
ownKey.fix: Open Settings › AI Providers to replace or test the key. Agents paused for this start again by themselves once the key works.
ownKey.footer: You get this as an Admin of the workspace, by your Chat settings' Notify me when an agent needs me.
ownKey.reminderFooter: A reminder: the key has not worked for 3 days. We send one.

why.noCredit: Your {provider} account is out of credit.
why.model: {provider} can't reach the model set for your key.
why.unreadable: Your saved {provider} key can't be read any more.

ownKeyLimit.title100: Your agents reached their monthly limit on your AI key
ownKeyLimit.title80: Your agents have used 80% of their monthly limit on your AI key
ownKeyLimit.body100: In {workspace}, agents have used {spent} they may spend on your own AI key this month, so the agents that run on it are paused. They start again by themselves when the month renews on {renews}, or when an Admin raises the limit in Settings › AI Providers. Chat you use yourself keeps working.
ownKeyLimit.body80: In {workspace}, agents have used {spent} they may spend on your own AI key this month. At the limit they pause until the month renews on {renews}, or until an Admin raises it in Settings › AI Providers.
ownKeyLimit.estimate: The amounts are an estimate at the providers' list prices. Your provider's bill is the real one.
ownKeyLimit.footer: You get this as an Admin of the workspace, by your Chat settings' Notify me when an agent needs me.

goLive.publishedBody: {agent} published the {brand} page “{title}” on {site} through {cms}, without a click. An Admin allowed this agent to publish and send on its own.
goLive.publishedNext: It passed Quality and your brand facts first. It is live now: check it, and if it shouldn’t be, use Take down on its notice in your Chat Inbox.
goLive.webhookBody: {agent} sent the {brand} page “{title}” to your webhook, without a click. An Admin allowed this agent to publish and send on its own.
goLive.webhookNext: It passed Quality and your brand facts first. Ansvisor can’t take a webhook send back: your workflow decides what happens to it.
goLive.draftBody: {agent} sent the {brand} page “{title}” to {cms} as a draft, without a click. An Admin allowed this agent to publish and send on its own.
goLive.draftNext: It passed Quality and your brand facts first. Nothing is live yet: the page waits in {cms} as a draft.
goLive.footer: You get this as the agent's owner or one of the people it notifies, by your Chat settings' Notify me when an agent needs me.
goLive.offSubject: {agent} no longer publishes on its own
goLive.offBody: {agent} changed, so it no longer publishes on its own. Turn it on again if you still want it: an Admin ticks Publish and send on its own on the agent's Mode & approvals step.
goLive.offFooter: You get this as the Admin who allowed the agent, or as its owner, by your Chat settings' Notify me when an agent needs me.
